versions.changelog:
- Initial release of disclosure-completion-assistant for patent agencies, inventors, and R&D teams.
- Provides a bilingual, 7-step HTML patent disclosure guide at `assets/disclosure-guide.html`.
- Structured process collects invention details and uses AI-assisted completion for better draft quality.
- Final editable draft highlights missing fields for further refinement.
- Features include field-by-field AI completion, example fill, and bilingual support.
- Requires configuration with the PatSnap MCP service for full functionality; guidance included for setup.
